component.title: MorphingIcon
component.purpose: MorphingIcon changes an icon's meaning in place while preserving geometry, accessibility, and reduced-motion policy.

states.description: Compatible geometry uses a true path morph.
Incompatible geometry chooses a graceful fallback.
A real control demonstrates an interruptible state change.

claims.statement: Meaningful icon states expose an accessible image name.
Reduced motion resolves immediately without losing the semantic state change.
The requested morph strategy falls back safely when registry geometry is incompatible.
